deep_analysis:
Flat (0 open trades) is the correct position — not caution, the trade itself. BTC sits at 81,403, BELOW its EMA300 (81,599) for 283 straight minutes, linreg LEAN_BEAR across all timeframes, zscore STRONG_NEG, volume LOW. The 15m scanner still says LONG_BIAS while the 4h says SHORT_BIAS; alt breadth (16 long vs 10 short) also leans long. That unresolved disagreement IS chop, and chop is where our account bleeds.

Verified 24h split (n=49 closed, 18W/29L, net -2.23): trades that reached the trail family won 14/16 (+0.55). Trades that exited via chop/slam (hard_max_loss, atr_sl_hit, hard_sl, stale_exit) won 1/26 (-2.70). Every dollar lost is a chop entry; every dollar won is a trend trailed. 7d is the same story at scale: 222 trades, 34% WR, -3.41.

We are on the wrong side of every loser because we keep entering non-trending markets as if they were trending. Three case studies from the last 24h, with the winning side named: (1) doji-bottom-long knifed 5 straight oversold LONGs (ZEN 29.5, CRV 39.8, YGG 48.8, WCT 27.8, MET 47.6). The winning side was SHORT continuation below the doji low — or flat. The only doji wins (GMT, SUSHI, ONDO, XPL, all via profit-monster-trail) entered at RSI 44-56 AFTER a base, not at the knife. (2) pump-chain- shorts went 8/36 (22%) over 7d, -0.66 — shorting individual alts while breadth leans long and BTC merely chops sideways is fighting bounce buyers. The winning side was LONG the pullback-to-support, or token-specific momentum (ACE, CC shorts that DID win had their own dumps). (3) ai-trader failure modes are both staleness/wrong-side: INJ LONG at meta_rsi 64.0 (sellers waiting at the extension, -0.20), APT LONG picked at 57.1 that collapsed to fill RSI 33.7 (-0.09 hard_max_loss). In both cases the winning side was the fade of our entry, not our entry.

Pipeline is correctly STOPPED (vacation-guardrail, 02:38 UTC). Restarting it in this regime re-opens the chop valve. The only live edge is the trail family — and trails need a trend BTC is not currently giving.

AI trader deliberately NOT fired this cycle despite 6 open slots: pipeline stopped + chop + the last 3 picks all lost (INJ -0.20, APT -0.09, streak of 3 on ai-trader-manual). A pick into a stopped pipeline in chop is pure negative expectancy. Skip is the right call.
regime_context:
BTC: 81,403, BELOW EMA300 (81,599) for 283 minutes, LEAN_BEAR, STRONG_DOWN, zscore STRONG_NEG, volume LOW, velocity SLOW, acceleration FLAT. State score collapsed to 2.7 (was 22.5 earlier today). Wyckoff ACCUMULATION / market phase RECOVERY. 15m LONG_BIAS vs 4h SHORT_BIAS = unresolved. Alt breadth 16 LONG_BIAS vs 10 SHORT_BIAS (aggregate LONG_BIAS) — alts want to bounce while BTC presses below trend. That divergence is the chop engine.

Meaning for positions: no regime edge for either direction. LONGs fight the BTC downtrend; SHORTs fight the alt-bounce breadth. Trail entries starve because neither side gets sustained follow-through. Hard stops get hunted by the oscillation. The system makes money by following trends — there is no trend to follow right now. Stay flat until BTC either reclaims EMA300 ~81,600 with volume (flip LONG-bias, trail family re-arms) or loses 81,000 breadth with breadth flipping SHORT (controlled SHORT bias). Until one side resolves, capital preservation IS alpha.
